TEAM / SERGE GERVAIS

SERGE GERVAIS

Co-Founder & Director of Scouting

Hockey has been part of Serge’s life for more than 40 years as a player, coach, manager, league administrator and scout. Those experiences have shaped an approach that looks beyond statistics to understand the complete player — hockey IQ, competitiveness, character, decision-making, consistency and potential for development.

As a scout, Serge focuses on what a player can become, not simply what they are today. His evaluation process looks closely at how a player reads the game, responds under pressure, competes without the puck, interacts with teammates and coaches, and adapts to different situations.

His background also includes more than a decade working with young people and experience overseeing a 10-team hockey league, strengthening his perspective on player development, leadership, coachability and organizational fit.

At CADIG, Serge’s scouting work combines live and video evaluation with analytics and hockey intelligence to help build an honest picture of each player’s strengths, development needs and long-term projection.
